title: Creative Decision to Editorial Plan Contract
description: Governs the deterministic translation of Creative Decisions into Editorial Plan Units without re-evaluating or contradicting creative choices.
translation_rules: HOLD decision in CDM MUST map to source_strategy = CURRENT_STATE (or PRESENTER at start), selected_technique_refs = [], and graphic_intent = NONE / inherited.
EVOLVE decision in CDM MUST preserve base visual source while allowing motivated typographic, graphic, or framing evolution.
SWITCH decision in CDM MUST declare source_strategy change and specify target media_intent and transition_intent.
Plan MUST NOT change state_decision (e.g. cannot turn SWITCH into HOLD). If an asset is unavailable, mark UNRESOLVED / PLAN_CONFLICT.
Editorial Plan MUST NOT introduce render-specific technical parameters (coords, font sizes, hex codes, dB, ms).
